runtime.model_identity: gpt-5.6-sol (fresh collaboration-agent context, inherited current configuration)
runtime.model_configuration: same inherited reasoning configuration for both arms; hidden internal reasoning budget uncontrolled
runtime.task_prompt: exact byte-identical frozen prompt for both arms within each case/trial
runtime.web_access: available equally to both arms; use only when material; primary/official sources required for technical or high-stakes claims
runtime.support_files: same canonical NOVUM 2.0.0 references/assets/scripts for both arms
runtime.installed_skill_isolation: Generation agents are instructed not to load the current installed NOVUM candidate; the designated frozen local SKILL.md is the sole task-specific runtime instruction. This is enforced by prompt isolation but not by a separate OS-level model sandbox.

known_limitations: same model family is not external replication
OS-level exclusion of globally installed skills is unavailable; agents receive an explicit sole-runtime-source instruction
tool-call metadata is self-reported by each fresh context
